## 2. Legal & Regulatory Framework (Queensland, Australia)

### 2.1 Governing Legislation
All electrical testing and compliance certification in Queensland is governed by:
1. **Electrical Safety Act 2002 (Queensland)**
2. **Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 (commenced 1 September 2026)** — Superseded the *Electrical Safety Regulation 2013*.
3. **AS/NZS 3000:2018 (Wiring Rules)** and associated standards (e.g., AS/NZS 3008, AS/NZS 3760, AS/NZS 4777, AS/NZS 5033).
4. **Electrical Safety Office (ESO) Queensland**: Form V7.09-2026 standard certificate layout.

### 2.2 Statutory Certificate Types
Queensland law strictly differentiates between two statutory certificates:

#### Section 229: Certificate of Testing and Compliance (Electrical Installation Work)
- **Scope**: Required for any electrical installation work, including new electrical installations, alterations, additions, repairs, switchboard upgrades, sub-mains, and solar PV or EV charger connections.
- **Timing**: Must be provided to the person for whom the work was performed as soon as practicable after the installation work is tested and connected to a source of electricity.
- **Verbatim Certification Text**:
  > *"I certify that the electrical installation, to the extent it is affected by the electrical work, has been tested to ensure that it is electrically safe and is in accordance with the requirements of the wiring rules and any other standard applying under the Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 to the electrical installation."*

#### Section 208: Certificate of Testing and Safety (Electrical Equipment Work)
- **Scope**: Required when repairing, altering, or servicing electrical equipment.
- **Timing**: Must be provided to the customer as soon as practicable after testing.
- **Verbatim Certification Text**:
  > *"I certify that the electrical equipment, to the extent it is affected by the electrical work, is electrically safe."*

### 2.3 Mandatory 5-Year Retention Obligation
Under **Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 s229(3)** and **s208(3)**, licensed electrical contractors are legally obligated to keep a copy of each certificate of testing and compliance or safety for **at least 5 years** after issuing the certificate.

Because QLD CoC Generator operates with 100% zero-cloud privacy (storing zero customer or contractor records on any external server), contractors must download, print, or locally back up generated certificates to satisfy their statutory record-keeping duties.

## 4. Technical Architecture & Security Pipeline

QLD CoC Generator employs a robust, purely client-side four-stage PDF generation pipeline:

```
[User Form Input & Presets]
           │
           ▼
Stage 1: Vector Layout & Typesetting (pdf-lib)
  ├── Smart Queensland Suburb Autocomplete (suburbs.js)
  ├── Base ESO Form V7.09-2026 Vector Injection
  └── Dynamic Multi-Page Line Splitting Engine
           │
           ▼
Stage 2: 200 DPI Anti-Tamper Image Baking (pdf.js worker)
  ├── High-fidelity rasterization (scale = 2.77778, JPEG Q=0.70)
  ├── Device-level physical fingerprinting (DEV-XXXX-XXXX)
  └── Flattens vector elements to prevent post-issuance tampering
           │
           ▼
Stage 3: Invisible In-Place Searchable Text Layer
  ├── Extracts exact affine transform coordinates (tx, ty) per glyph
  └── Overlays opacity: 0 WinAnsi character stream in 1:1 sub-pixel alignment
           │
           ▼
Stage 4: ISO 32000-1 Metadata & Delivery
  ├── Sets Author, Title, Subject, Creator, and Producer
  ├── Output file size ~230 KB per page (strictly < 280 KB budget)
  └── Native Web Share API (AirDrop, Email, WhatsApp) & A4 Print
```

### 4.1 Anti-Tamper Baking & Device ID
- To prevent post-issuance alteration (a widespread risk with editable PDF forms in commercial disputes), certificates are rasterized into unalterable flat images at 200 DPI.
- A unique physical **Device ID** (e.g., `DEV-4A8F-9C12`) is generated from client hardware entropy and permanently stamped at the bottom-left of each certificate.

### 4.2 In-Place OCR Searchable Text Layer
- Traditional image-based PDFs cannot be searched or copied. QLD CoC Generator solves this by injecting an invisible (`opacity: 0`) text stream directly over the baked image.
- Because text coordinates precisely match the visual raster layer (`error < 2.0pt`), users can naturally highlight, select, copy, and search (`Ctrl+F`) text across Adobe Acrobat, macOS Spotlight, Windows Search, iOS Files, and Google Drive.

### 4.3 Multi-Page Capacity Matrix
- **Single-Page Standard** (9.0pt font / 12.0pt leading): Comfortably accommodates **1 to 15 lines** of work description.
- **Single-Page Compact** (8.0pt font / 10.5pt leading): Dynamically compresses **16 to 18 lines** to remain strictly on Page 1.
- **Multi-Page Mode** (>18 lines):
  - Automatically triggers multi-page layout.
  - Page 1 carries **13 lines** with a bottom continuation notice `--- Continued on Page 2 ---`.
  - Continuation pages carry **41 to 42 lines**.
  - **Critical Legal Compliance**: Every single continuation page features a dedicated legal details bar at the bottom (`y = 138`) displaying Customer Name, Site Address, Contractor Licence Number, Testing Dates, and the Tester's digital signature. This guarantees that any single sheet detached from the document remains an independently valid legal record.

## 5. Standard Trade Work Presets & Typical Scenarios

The generator includes built-in one-tap presets tailored for high-volume electrical contractor workflows in Queensland, each citing AS/NZS 3000:2018 and applicable statutory standards:

1. **Smoke Alarms (s229 Installation)**:
   > *"Supply, install, and test interconnected photoelectric smoke alarms in accordance with AS 3786:2014, AS/NZS 3000:2018, Fire and Emergency Services Act 1990 (s104RBA), and Building Regulation 2021: Alarms installed, prescribed locations verified, operational test and tactile hush verified, earth continuity, polarity, and insulation resistance tested and compliant."*
2. **Battery Energy Storage System (s229 Installation)**:
   > *"Install battery energy storage system (BESS) in accordance with AS/NZS 5139:2019, AS/NZS 4777.1, and AS/NZS 3000:2018: Dedicated sub-board / PVDB with EPS main switch & manual changeover switch, essential backup sub-circuits relocated downstream, earth continuity (<0.5 Ohm), insulation resistance (>1.0 MOhm), polarity, EFLI, and RCD operation verified."*
3. **Solar PV System (s229 Installation)**:
   > *"Supply and install grid-connected rooftop photovoltaic (PV) solar system in accordance with AS/NZS 5033:2021, AS/NZS 4777.1, and AS/NZS 3000:2018: AC/DC isolation switches and circuit protection installed and labelled, anti-islanding protection and grid disconnection verified, array insulation resistance, earth continuity, and polarity tested and compliant."*
4. **EV Charger Installation (s229 Installation)**:
   > *"Supply and install dedicated electric vehicle (EV) charging station circuit in accordance with AS/NZS 3000:2018 (Section 7.9) and Queensland Electricity Connection Manual (QECM): Dedicated sub-circuit wired from main switchboard with compliant cable sizing, dedicated Type A/B RCBO (30mA with DC fault detection), earth continuity, insulation resistance (>1.0 MOhm), EFLI, and RCD trip time tested."*
5. **Switchboard Upgrade & Alteration (s229 Installation)**:
   > *"Switchboard upgrade and alteration carried out in accordance with AS/NZS 3000:2018 and Queensland Electricity Connection Manual (QECM): Existing fuse board replaced with compliant enclosure and new main switch, final sub-circuits protected by individual Type A RCBOs (30mA), main earthing and MEN connection tested (<0.5 Ohm), SPD installed, consumer mains/sub-mains tested (IR & polarity), and final sub-circuits tested (earth continuity, IR, polarity, EFLI, RCD trip times)."*

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Who can issue a Queensland Certificate of Testing and Compliance?
**A**: Only licensed electrical contractors (or qualified persons authorized under a contractor licence) who have tested the electrical work to ensure it is electrically safe and compliant with AS/NZS 3000 can issue this certificate.

### Q: Is this a government app?
**A**: No. QLD CoC Generator is an independent, free productivity tool engineered by Kai Electrical Tech Pty Ltd. It precisely formats data into Queensland Electrical Safety Office Form V7.09-2026 specifications.

### Q: Does the app save customer data or job details to a cloud server?
**A**: Absolutely not. The application is built on a 100% client-side static architecture. All contractor profiles, draft entries, client addresses, and signatures remain strictly inside your browser's local storage (`localStorage`).

### Q: Can I use QLD CoC Generator without an internet connection?
**A**: Yes. By adding the application to your mobile Home Screen (PWA), the entire engine is cached offline. You can generate, bake, sign, and export compliance certificates on remote job sites without mobile reception.
